title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer of approximately 10^{-13} cm.

title: Correct Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and use the formula for the Compton wavelength.

title: Substitution Accuracy
description: Important Criteria: The student must accurately substitute the values for hbar, mass of the proton, and speed of light into the formula.

title: Calculation Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student should show clear steps in the calculation leading to the final answer.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factor usage.
